title: Senior Full-stack (PHP + React) Developer (Warsaw hybrid)
description:
About the Company

Digis is an international technology company, part of Fiverr (NYSE: FVRR), with 250+ specialists delivering high-load SaaS platforms, enterprise solutions, and cloud-native products for clients worldwide. We build long-term engineering teams and ensure transparency, stability, and professional growth for every talent.

 

About the Project

Large SaaS platform in the e-commerce domain that automates store operations for online sellers. The platform covers product importing, inventory and price synchronization, supplier integrations, order fullfillment automation, and marketplace management.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Create new landing pages and test paid vs. free funnel models
  • Integrate payment flows, including Stripe, into new funnel experiences
  • Develop and test alternative versions of existing flows for A/B testing
  • Integrate with Shopify and other external APIs used in the funnel
  • Support and extend the existing PHP/WordPress-based funnel when needed
  • Gradually migrate parts of the existing solution toward React and newer architecture

 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of general software development experience
  • Hands-on experience with PHP
  • Hands-on experience with ReactJS
  • Experience with WordPress
  • English level: Upper-Intermediate or higher

 

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Long-term cooperation and stability
  • Hybrid work model: 3 days per week in the Warsaw office
  • Proven product with around 10 years of successful operation
  • Strong company backing as part of the Fiverr Group
  • New team built from scratch with room to shape its ways of working
  • Bi-weekly engineering discussions on architecture, implementation, and knowledge sharing
  • AI-powered development supported by the client, including Claude Code for coding, refactoring, PR reviews, and Jira/Confluence tasks

 

When applying, please confirm that you are able to work in a hybrid format and visit our Warsaw office 3 times per week.

 

If your experience is a strong match for this position, we’ll be happy to reach out to you to discuss the next steps.
